seo.metaTitle: LaTuaAuto — Chat by license plate and automatic car deadlines
seo.metaDescription: Headlights left on? Boxed in? Warn the owner by writing to the plate, no phone numbers. Revisione, bollo, RCA, tyres and fines: your Italian car deadlines fill themselves in.

home.heroTitle: Write to the plate. Not to the person.
home.heroText: Headlights on, window open, a car boxing you in: warn the owner in one tap, without knowing a name or a number. And your car's deadlines fill themselves in.
home.heroBadge: Free · No GPS · No phone number

verified.title: Unverified accounts don't receive

templates.title: First contact is preset-only

fine.title: Fines: the two clocks that matter

noGps.title: No location, no phone
noGps.text: We never request or store your position. No phone number needed. Just email and plate.

qr.title: QR sticker for people without the app

home.howTitle: How it works in three steps

step1.title: Register your car
step1.text: Email and plate. Then prove the car is yours with the registration document: the image stays on your phone.

step2.title: Deadlines arrive by themselves
step2.text: From the plate and registration date we compute revisione, tyres, licence. You confirm in one tap.

step3.title: Warn or be warned
step3.text: See a car with its lights on? Write to the plate. Someone boxed you in? Reach them in one tap.

home.trustTitle: Built for Italy, by the book
home.trustText: A plate is personal data (Court of Cassation, Italian DPA). That is why LaTuaAuto never exposes who is behind a plate, never lets anyone find out whether a plate is registered, and tracks nobody. Safety before features.
home.ctaText: The app rolls out city by city. Meanwhile, try the deadline calculator: free, no sign-up.

how.title: How LaTuaAuto works
how.intro: A service with two sides: the sender and the receiver. Both designed so they cannot be abused.

sender.title: If you want to warn someone
steps: Enter the vehicle's plate (car, motorcycle or trailer).
Pick the alert: headlights on, window open, you boxed me in, dangerous parking, flat tyre, alarm, fluid leak, damaged car.
If the owner is verified they get the notification. If they reply, free chat opens. If they don't reply within 48 hours, the thread closes by itself.
We never tell you whether a plate is registered: a reply is the only signal.

receiver.title: If you want to be warned
steps: Register email and plate. You can write to others right away, but you don't receive yet.
Basic verification: plate + last 4 characters of the VIN, matched against official public data.
Full verification: photograph the registration document. OCR runs on your phone; we only get a yes/no. The image is never sent or stored.
Once verified you receive alerts, choose who may write to you, and block in one tap.

how.deadlinesText: From the plate and registration date we compute revisione (4 years, then every 2), RCA, regional bollo, winter tyres (15 October – 15 November) and licence renewal by age. Servicing is estimated by mileage or time. All in one calendar with reminders at 30, 15 and 3 days.
how.fineTitle: Fines: you photograph, we count the days
how.fineText: 30% reduced payment within 5 days of notification; appeal to the Justice of the Peace within 30 days; appeal to the Prefect within 60. Deadlines falling on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday move to the next working day. It is a reminder, not legal advice.

safety.title: Safety and privacy
safety.intro: A service linking a plate to a person can become a harassment tool. We designed LaTuaAuto so that it cannot.

principles.title: A plate is personal data
principles.text: The Court of Cassation says so and the Italian DPA enforces it. We treat it accordingly: stored in protected form, never shown to third parties, never in a public directory.

principles.title: No location, no phone
principles.text: We do not use GPS, do not ask for a phone number, do not store where you are when you write.

principles.title: We never say whether a plate is registered
principles.text: A service answering "this plate exists" becomes a people search engine. Ours does not.

principles.title: Unverified accounts don't receive
principles.text: You can write immediately, but you only receive after proving the car is yours. Nobody can intercept alerts meant for you.

principles.title: First contact is preset-only
principles.text: Free text opens only when you reply. At most five new contacts per day per user. Unaccepted threads expire in 48 hours.

principles.title: Block and report in one tap
principles.text: Every report gets a reasoned decision. Whoever uses someone else's plate for harassment, fraud or stalking is removed.

principles.title: No "online", no "typing"
principles.text: No indicators revealing your habits. No public profile.

principles.title: Data in Europe
principles.text: Servers in the European Union. No data sales. Account deletion removes everything it contains.

safety.legalNote: Legal information on this page is provided for information only and does not constitute legal advice.

items.q: How do I write to a car's owner without knowing them?
items.a: Enter the plate and pick a preset alert. If the owner is registered and verified, they get a notification and can reply. You never see their name, email or phone.

items.q: Can someone register my plate and read messages meant for me?
items.a: No. Whoever registers a plate without verifying it can only write, not receive. Alerts only reach the account that proved it owns the car.

items.q: Does LaTuaAuto reveal who is behind a plate?
items.a: Never. There is no plate search returning a person, and we do not even say whether a plate is registered.

Revisione (4 years from first registration, then every 2), winter and summer tyres, licence renewal by age, servicing by mileage or time, fine deadlines. RCA and bollo from the data you enter or from the official check.
Basic use is free: one plate, chat and essential reminders. A Premium plan will add more vehicles, a maintenance log with PDF and advanced reminders.

items.q: Do you use GPS or my phone number?
items.a: No. We do not use location and do not ask for a phone. You sign up with email and plate.
Block in one tap and the thread disappears. You can report: every report gets a reasoned decision and abusers are removed.
Yes. The Court of Cassation established it and the Italian DPA enforces it. That is why we store it in protected form and never expose it.

sections.p: Email, password (hashed), plate and vehicle data you enter, exchanged messages, reminders, date of birth if you use the licence reminder, IP address at login (90 days, security). No location, no phone number.
Performance of the service (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR); legitimate interest in road safety and abuse prevention (Art. 6(1)(f)), documented with a balancing test; consent for optional features (Art. 6(1)(a)).
We store it in protected form, do not show it to third parties and do not answer "is this plate registered?".
As long as the account exists. Unaccepted threads: 48 hours. Login IP: 90 days. Contact messages: 12 months.
Access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, objection; complaint to the Italian Data Protection Authority.
Servers in the European Union. No transfers outside the EU.

You receive messages only after verifying you own the vehicle. False declarations lead to removal.
